scripts.dev: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @teamchat/shared" "npm run dev -w @teamchat/api" "npm run dev -w @teamchat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && npm run build -w @teamchat/api && npm run build -w @teamchat/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @teamchat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @teamchat/shared && npm run test:e2e
